quote_repairs.replacement_quote: To build the connections between molecular and protein structures with natural language, we perform multimodal fine-tuning, which involves answering questions with regard to a given molecule or protein. As shown in Table 1, we design prompt templates to help BioMedGPT-LM understand the context more accurately in a role-play manner. The <moleculeHere> and <proteinHere> symbolics represent the aligned molecular and protein features, where each atom of a molecule and each residue of a protein is considered as a token. {text_input} is populated by questions in the training set, and {text_output} is populated by answers to calculate the auto-regressive loss.
